main_text.l: ut verius dicamus, ut ingenti sublimium,
& Christianissimorum nostrorum Imperatorum, &
ante vim illatam, consensu precibusque universæ
Dei Constantinopolitanæ Ecclesiæ. His acquie-
scunt Romani, sic turbante ac convoluente
omnia Photio. Est tamen id contra
Constitutiones, & canones Ecclesiasticos, quod
alibi fusius probavimus. Ante siquidem
omnia assensus Romani requirebatur, &
pœnitentia prævia. Sed nolo cum aliis
contendere. Calculum Photius det, non
longe sed ab hac eadem Actione peti-
tum. Peccavit in Potium Thomas Bery-
tensis Photium respuens, postmodum pœ-
nitentia ductus, si hoc quoque mendacium[?]
Photij non est, delictum confitetur, & in
communionem petit admitti. Sed esto, er-
raverit ille, & pœnitentiam egerit, ut hoc
Photio concedam. Nanque in Epistola
Michaëlis Alexandrini legitur; Ο᾿ ἀ[?]έπεμψω αὐτὸν Θωμᾶς ὁ Βηρυταῖος ἐπίγνω τὸ πλάσμα
Ἰωάννου, ἐ αἰτίαν [illegible, ~12 letters] συγγνώμης. Alius vero ipsorum Thomas Bery-
tensis agnovit errorem suum, & cum postulasset
veniam, illam a nobis impetravit: Et Abra-
mius Amedorum, & Samosatorum Metro-
polita Epistolam ad Photium de eodem Thoma, Περὶ μὲν οὖν Θωμᾶ τῆς Τύρου, καὶ Ἡλίας, καὶ Ἰωάννη τῷ ἀπεσταλμένῳ[?] τῷ

page.notes: Greek passages are only partly legible at this scan resolution; uncertain Greek letters and words are marked [?] or left as illegible. "refpuens" is read as respuens, and "mendaciim" as mendacium, both uncertain. "det" is printed as seen (possibly a printing error for dedit). Long s and u/v were normalised as instructed. No running head, catchword or signature is visible.
